profile.headline: Software Engineer III
profile.geoLocationName: Fort Walton Beach, Florida, United States
profile.summary: Currently, I work as a Software Engineer for a company called DCS Corporation, which specialize in making custom software for the U.S. Military.  I have experience as a Software Engineer (VUE 3 & Vuetify 3 on the frontend w/ASP.net C# on the backend) and Full Stack PHP Web Developer with a focus on Web Application Integration and Automation.  Plus, I'm studying Agentic AI, the Agentic SDLC and Training AI Agents.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Help create, migrate & maintain custom applications with WebAPI EndPoints on the backend using ASP.net & Vue 3 w/Vuetify 3 on the frontend. The largest task was to help the team migrate from Vue2 over to Vue3, which also meant we had to migrate from Vuetify 2 to Vuetify 3.
positions.insights: Skills: SASS · SQL Server Management Studio · Document Object Model (DOM) · Vue · Vuetify · ASP.NET Web API · ASP.NET MVC · C#

positions.title: Contractor 1099 (Software Engineer)
positions.locationName: Miramar Beach, Florida, United States · Remote
positions.description: I worked on an AI Project where I used Python code to connect and send old product descriptions to chatGPT which in turn generated NEW product descriptions that were used to create an Excel spreadsheet with existing product data for upload into the SHOPIFY platform.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: Fort Walton Beach, Florida, United States
positions.description: I help troubleshoot & make enhancements to our custom suite of in-house development tools (i.e. System Editor, Level Editor & the Workspace Converter) used by  our Platform Integration Team to develop digital twins.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Node.js · Python (Programming Language) · Vue.js · TypeScript · Docker · JavaScript · QT5 · C# · CMake · Git

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: 12598 US Hwy 98 W, Suite 200, Miramar Beach, FL 32550
positions.description: This role is responsible for front and back-end web development in support of business and marketing initiatives, from third-party integrations to front-end template development to marketing website asset executions.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Maintain in-house websites using PHP & MySQL.  Create and build new websites for other areas of the company using CakePHP and assist with email marketing campaigns.

positions.title: Technical Applications Representative
positions.description: Customer Support for CPSI Applications - Our team help customers using CPSI software to get over common error messages and help utilize our software in the proper manner on their network to deliver quality patient care in their facility. A lot of times these issues may be network ports being blocked by firewalls or security software to reinstalling the software to get pass any corrupted files in the software.
